ownerDecision.instruction: Close Gekta issue #4332 without weakening production acceptance; preserve keyboard ownership across transient focus loss and preserve controlled composer drafts under real Safari/WebKit input events.

constraints: Do not weaken viewport, overlap, draft, caret, localization, touch-target or exact-revision gates.

A contracted visual viewport may retain keyboard ownership after transient focus loss only after a text-entry control was engaged; ownership must clear after the viewport expands below the keyboard threshold.
Composer edits must update the controlled draft from native input events in Chromium and WebKit without test-only fallbacks.
No backend, auth, model, database, registration, role or business-logic changes.
